fusions.name: Spoken Snare
fusions.desc: A practiced binding word that reaches an enemy up to 8 tiles away and deals 28 arcane damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, ignoring resistance.

fusions.name: Binding Syllable
fusions.desc: Deals 10 arcane damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, strips 15% armour for 6 seconds and slows each by 20%. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Pattern
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Drilled Form
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
